summaries.name: Grandoozy
summaries.summary: Grandoozy is a relatively new Denver music festival featuring a diverse lineup of acts, from rock and pop to hip-hop and electronic music.

summaries.name: Denver Folk Festival
summaries.summary: Denver Folk Festival is a Denver music festival focused on folk, bluegrass, and roots music.

summaries.name: Denver Jazz Festival
summaries.summary: Denver Jazz Festival celebrates jazz in all its forms, featuring local and national acts in Denver.

summaries.name: Westword Music Showcase
summaries.summary: Westword Music Showcase is a one-day Denver music festival featuring local and national acts, with a focus on showcasing Denver's thriving music scene.

summaries.name: Riot Fest Denver
summaries.summary: Riot Fest Denver is a punk, rock, and alternative music festival that takes place in Denver in September.

summaries.name: Twist & Shout Records
summaries.summary: Twist & Shout Records is a legendary Denver record store with an impressive selection of vinyl and CDs.

summaries.name: The hi-dive
summaries.summary: The hi-dive is a Denver music venue and bar that hosts local and touring acts, with a focus on punk, indie, and alternative music.

summaries.name: The Marquis Theater
summaries.summary: The Marquis Theater is a mid-sized Denver music venue that hosts a range of acts, from rock and pop to hip-hop and electronic music.
